name: Archaeological Ruins at Moenjodaro
description: Moenjodaro, in Pakistan's Sindh province, is the ruined heart of one of the world's earliest big cities, built around 2500 BCE and home to perhaps 40,000 people. Walking its mud-brick streets, you can trace a gridlike lower town and a raised citadel on massive embankments. The city was abandoned by about 1700 BCE and rediscovered in the 1920s.
